name: Infinite Inertial Menu
description: Full-screen vertical menu of large serif labels that loops infinitely and is driven by wheel or drag, with inertial easing, scale and tilt that respond to scroll speed.
contents: Vertical list of large menu labels with a numbered script-font index beside each
behavior: Mouse wheel and drag or touch move the list with lerped inertia
Items wrap endlessly in a vertical loop
Items shrink and rotate slightly based on scroll speed
Hovering a label scales it and nudges its number

needsCodeEdit.where: button element inside the li in the menuItems map

fixed: Listens to window wheel events while mounted, without blocking page scroll
Uses Playfair Display and Playball fonts loaded from Google Fonts
